groups.title: Social sign-in: 2 centred buttons on live vs a row of 8 in the design
groups.summary: The design shows 8 round social buttons (Google, Facebook, Apple, LinkedIn, Microsoft, LINE, KakaoTalk, passkey) spanning the form width from x=870. Live only has Google and Facebook, centred (starting at x=1034, 19px lower). The missing icons, the shifted left edge and the 'Microsoft → Facebook' colour mismatch all come from that one change.

groups.title: Log in button 6px taller (46 → 52px), label almost invisible
groups.summary: The disabled 'Log in' button is 52px tall on live vs 46px in the design, pushing everything below it down ~9-19px. Its label is so faint on live that it is not detected at all.

groups.title: Field labels sit ~3px further above their inputs
groups.summary: USERNAME / EMAIL and PASSWORD labels have an 8px gap to their input in the design and ~11px on live (live also drops the space before the red asterisk). In the design the label was close enough to merge with the input box, hence the missing/extra pair.

groups.title: 'or' separator: lighter label and visible divider lines on live
groups.summary: The 'or' divider under the Log in button: live's 'or' text is a lighter neutral grey (#6e7b84 → #b9b9b9) and its two hairlines are strong enough to be detected, where the design's are fainter.

groups.title: Marketing headline smaller (31 → 28px text height)
groups.summary: 'Better work in half the time.' on the left panel is set ~10% smaller on live (it ends at x≈511 instead of 549).

groups.title: 'Log in' title is neutral black instead of the design's blue-tinted ink
groups.summary: The page title uses #171717 on live where the design uses ink #0e2332.

groups.title: First benefit bullet copy/stats differ (content)
groups.summary: Design: 'Access 74,540,405 creative assets (89,304 added yesterday)'. Live: 'Access 60,869,326 creative assets' with no 'added yesterday' part, so the line is shorter. Live data, not a styling issue.
